content.text: 🚨Amid unverified claims and reports of Benjamin Netanyahu being assassinated doing rounds on social media, the Israeli Prime Minister's office reportedly dismissed the "fake news" and said that the PM is "fine".LINK IN BIO to read more 🔗#BenjaminNetanyahu #Israel #FakeNews #Misinformation #IsraelPM #SocialMediaRumours #WorldNews(Benjamin Netanyahu, Israeli PM, Fake news, Social media claims, Israel PMO, Misinformation, World news)Where is he? Why did he have 6 fingers in his last video?He was sick because of cancer. That would be the argument to avoid humiliationKutte saheed ki maut nahi mar sakte ...wo kutte ki hi maut maregaHe is wounded and in Germany😂😂😂😂😂😂 ek puri community phir sadme chli gyi ye khabar sunkeIf Benjamin Netanyahu is really alive and completely fine, then where is the proof?Why hasn’t any recent video or live statement of him been released yet?In today’s time, even small incidents get recorded and spread on social media within minutes. But when such a big claim is being discussed about a country’s Prime Minister, there is still no clear video or live appearance. Why?Just saying “PM is fine” is not enough. If everything is normal, then why not release a short video to clear all the doubts?Explain 6 fingers then 😂This outfit is so outdated 😂😂
